claims.statement: For q equal to verified pre-state, no write, target write and hidden write are level-observationally identical although current event/source facts differ.
claims.domain: One binary hold-or-write trial with sources none/target/hidden.
premises: Any write sets the level to q
Observation contains only pre-state, challenge and final level
claims.proof: Twelve-history exhaustive enumeration; two same-value level classes have size three.
claims.thought_experiment_role: Fix displayed value while varying present event and source.

claims.statement: For q unequal to pre-state, a level change establishes some write in the declared model but does not distinguish target from hidden writer.
claims.proof: Two changed-value observation classes each contain target and hidden histories.
counterexamples: parallel bus master writing the same value
claims.thought_experiment_role: Shows A4E event necessity and A4D writer completeness are separate conjuncts.

claims.statement: Verified anti-current challenge plus baseline change, target-cut hold and same-interface rescue change supports a current target-route contribution when every A4D writer/completeness and locality premise is jointly satisfied.
claims.domain: One bounded device, declared binary transition law and one trial family.
claims.proof: The challenge makes positive-arm changes require a write; cut removes the target contribution; rescue restores it through the declared interface. A4D premises exclude alternative timely writers.
claims.thought_experiment_role: Provides the bounded return condition to actual organization without entering H_way.
